title: Disagree with the draft while it is still cheap to change
method: A conceptual sequence for the reflection exercise in this essay. The steps describe a possible practice, not a measured causal effect or a universal rule.
alt: Concept diagram: Clarify the review — Name the decision and what is open to change.; Locate the concern — Point to a claim, assumption, or missing case.; Explain the consequence — Distinguish errors from preferences.; Review the revision — Check the evidence and close resolved concerns..
